title: Vent connectors located in unconditioned areas.
officialText: Where the vent connector used for an appliance having a draft hood or a Category I appliance is located in or passes through attics, crawl spaces or other unconditioned spaces, that portion of the vent connector shall be listed Type B or Type L or listed vent material having equivalent insulation properties.
